why: A (universes at 0) is Whitney for COMPACT Hausdorff manifolds (any finite-dimensional model E) into SOME ℝᴺ: a smooth closed embedding with injective differential whose image is a slice submanifold; an embedding into ℝ^{K+1}, K ≥ 1, with room n + m = K + 1 for any prescribed n; and a diffeomorphism onto a compact slice submanifold. Content: B is much stronger mathematically than A; A only has the slice-submanifold packaging, which is glue.
